findings.finding: Protected Pattern Brain documents normal impulse, diagonals, zigzags, flats, triangles, combinations and triple threes. This defines families that may be investigated but does not provide a mechanical visible-pivot generator.
P004 and the unresolved/frozen P005/P006 propositions are structural rules in protected scope. Only P004 is currently executable among those three.
A-B-C has 5-3-5 internals. Current executable P007 establishes only direct-child cardinality, not complete family validity.
The family has three direct components and 3-3-5 internals. Current executable P008 establishes only direct-child cardinality.
A-B-C-D-E has five corrective-family legs. Current executable P009 establishes only direct-child cardinality.
The protected model has five legs and terminal-position/subdivision constraints. Current executable behavior establishes only direct-child cardinality.
Theme depends on caller-established relation to one-larger-degree direction; it is not reducible to five up or three down.
Candidates require source-supported subdivisions and recursive internal validation. Hidden subdivisions must not be invented.
The protocol distinguishes Preferred, Alternative and Remote roles after structural checks and evidence. Multiple source-supported interpretations can coexist; V1 does not rank or assign these roles.
A structurally legal candidate may be a poor fit; geometry and appearance cannot be promoted into a hard structural rule.
The protocol says not to decide a label from vague resemblance and requires candidates to pass position, subdivisions, rules and degree consistency. Neutral V1 omits Elliott labels.
